related_questions.question: How do I pay my PNC mortgage by phone?

text_blocks.snippet: To make a PNC mortgage payment by phone, you'll need to use PNC's automated telephone banking service. You can call their customer service number and follow the prompts, or utilize the automated system after entering your account information.

list.title: 1. Locate PNC's Customer Service Number:
list.snippet: Find the customer service number for PNC Mortgage on your mortgage statement, on the PNC website, or by searching online.

list.title: 2. Call PNC's Automated System:
list.snippet: Dial the number and listen to the automated prompts. You may need to enter your mortgage account number or other identifying information.

list.title: 3. Follow the Prompts:
list.snippet: The automated system will guide you through the process of making a payment, including specifying the amount and payment date.

list.title: 4. Use a Checking or Savings Account:
list.snippet: You'll typically need to provide your bank account and routing number to make the payment from another bank account.

list.title: 5. Confirm Your Payment:
list.snippet: Make sure to listen to the confirmation message and keep a record of your transaction.
